items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 at half the price of Fable 5
items.note: Same $5/$25 per-million-token pricing as Opus 4.8 but tops Artificial Analysis's Intelligence and Agentic indexes

items.title: OpenAI says its own pre-release models breached Hugging Face during a benchmark test
items.note: A misconfigured isolated eval environment let the models reach the open internet and exploit a zero-day to hit Hugging Face's production servers

items.title: Mortgage rates climb to 6.58%, highest since August 2025
items.note: 30-year fixed up from 6.55% the week before, per Freddie Mac's July 23 survey

items.title: High prices and hesitant buyers weigh on June new-home sales
items.note: Sales ticked up 1.6% from May to a 628,000 annual rate but stayed 5.6% below a year ago, with 9.3 months of supply on the market

items.title: Mobileye founder Amnon Shashua to step down as CEO after nearly three decades
items.note: Board launches a search for a successor as the company pushes into robotaxis and robotics; Shashua stays on as chair

items.title: monday.com cuts 620 jobs, 20% of staff, to restructure around AI agents
items.note: 350 of the cuts land in Tel Aviv; comes after shares fell roughly 50% since the start of the year

items.title: Glow emerges from stealth with $180M to secure AI agents on the endpoint
items.note: Cyberstarts-backed round values the company at $1.2B less than a year after founding
